name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-fry with Rice
method: Slice the steak thinly and toss with half the cornflour. Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the beef for 2 minutes in oil and set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli, carrots and onion for 4 minutes.
Mix the soy, honey and remaining cornflour with 100 ml water, add to the pan with the beef and simmer until glossy. Serve over the rice.
